figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS INTEGER))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS INTEGER) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort), y AS (SELECT a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7) m,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) active FROM a JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id AND o.channel='online' GROUP BY a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7)) SELECT x.cohort,x.k month_offset,x.n cohort_size,COALESCE(y.active,0) active_customers,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(y.active,0)/x.n,2) retention_pct FROM x LEFT JOIN y ON y.cohort=x.cohort AND y.m=x.month_key WHERE x.k BETWEEN 0 AND 6 ORDER BY x.cohort,x.k

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id),
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 a，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort),
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 b，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'),
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 m，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS INTEGER))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS INTEGER) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort),
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 x，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: y AS (SELECT a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7) m,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) active FROM a JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id AND o.channel='online' GROUP BY a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7))
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 y，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 来源
parts.sql: FROM x LEFT JOIN y ON y.cohort=x.cohort AND y.m=x.month_key
parts.note: 数据来自 中间结果 x、中间结果 y，并用 ON 后面的条件把它们的行配起来。

parts.label: 筛选
parts.note: 只保留满足这个条件的行：x.k BETWEEN 0 AND 6。
